technical.summary: COST shows strong trend structure and momentum confluence but is overbought across multiple timeframes with declining RSI momentum, limiting swing entry probability despite bullish technicals.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, earnings in 63 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed retail sentiment (bearish 40% vs bullish 28%) with neutral fear/greed (45) provides no clear directional bias for COST.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (351.2) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 63 days present binary event risk; COST defensiveness offers limited offset to systemic risk environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong trend structure (price above EMA-200, ADX trending, Supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) with rising OBV provides technical confluence for continuation if overbought conditions resolve.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought across all momentum oscillators (RSI-21, Stochastic, Williams %R) with declining RSI momentum, combined with severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, NFP volatility in 2 days, earnings binary risk in 63 days), creates asymmetric risk-reward favoring avoidance.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure remains bullish with price above EMA-200 and Supertrend confirmation, but overbought conditions across all momentum oscillators severely limit swing entry probability.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (351.2), and NFP volatility in 2 days create systemic headwinds that override technical strength; earnings binary risk in 63 days adds material downside asymmetry.
decision.recommended_exit: If forced to enter: atr_trail_1x with hard stop at recent swing low; otherwise avoid entry entirely.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish macro environment and overbought technicals outweighing bullish trend structure
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding COST with 57 existing Consumer Staples positions (16.6% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure further reduce conviction for new entry.
